framing: dated declarations, not admits, not edge

rules.rule: Fill every candidate window at the posted public mark. entry_edge=0.0.
rules.falsifier: Not a claim. Naming this is not evidence of edge.
rules.note: This is the loop's current behavior, dated so later selection rules cannot pretend the undeclared overnight was their OOS.

rules.rule: Skip the paper fill when posted_yes is strictly inside (0.45, 0.55). Otherwise fill at the posted mark with entry_edge=0.0.
rules.falsifier: After the n named by the evidence bar in force (currently looks.first_look_n = 70), if selected-fill settlement_pnl cannot be distinguished from R-BASELINE-FILL-ALL on those same windows, park this rule. Do not retune the band. The bar is the governing source.
rules.note: The (0.45, 0.55) band is not verifiably pre-registered — see the bar Pre-registration section. A note field asserting blind choice is not proof. execution=false (not flipped this turn). paper.py now consults decide() but this rule is not the executing rule. OOS still accumulates from declared_at by replay; replayed results are not lived results. L1 cannot support Established.

rules.rule: Skip the paper fill when yes_bid or yes_ask is missing, or when (yes_bid + yes_ask) / 2 is not in (0, 1). Fill at the posted mark with entry_edge=0.0 only when both sides are present and produce a mid. This is the mid branch of public_mid_or_last; last and ask-only fallbacks are skips.
rules.falsifier: After the n named by the evidence bar in force (currently looks.first_look_n = 70), if selected-fill settlement_pnl cannot be distinguished from R-BASELINE-FILL-ALL on those same windows, park this rule. Do not add a numeric mark band. Do not retune a threshold this rule does not have. The bar is the governing source.
rules.note: Parameter-free. No mark band. Not a revival of R-SKIP-COINFLIP. Not burned SPREAD. decide() cannot express this until the signature carries yes_bid/yes_ask or mark_source; execution stays false. Lab did not score. See LEARNING_LANE_15M_LAB_PROPOSED_02.md.
